target: Native Mac app shell and Gallery generation workspace

contract.purpose: Make a Mac-local model run easy to start, read, and inspect in the native app.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, owner screenshot and Issue #176 selection
contract.canonicalPurpose: PostTrainLLM turns learning into inspectable local artifacts and bounded specialist objectives into evidence-gated Mac-local factory runs.
contract.audience: Learners and practitioners running and evaluating local models on Apple Silicon.
contract.job: Show the selected model, prompt, Generate action, completion, sampling controls, and local status together without clipping or duplicate output.
contract.thesis: A focused dark research bench with a compact labeled workspace rail, one structured run record, a fixed prompt composer, and a clear parameter inspector.
contract.system: Deep ink surfaces, teal live/action signals, restrained coral warnings, compact monospaced evidence labels, generous run-record spacing, and a scrollable labeled rail.
contract.signature: One inspectable local run record replaces a duplicated transcript, with the next prompt anchored below it and the MLX sampling recipe beside it.
contract.risk: The compact rail could weaken discoverability; every icon keeps a visible label, tooltip, and accessibility name, and all workspaces remain reachable.
